narr: A robust moisture plume from an atmospheric river event moved across the region. The available moisture in combination with orographic lift resulted in the development of a couple of thunderstorms across the foothills to the north and east of Phoenix during the afternoon hours.
ev: Video submitted on social media showed Circle Mountain Road inundated by a fast-running wash. No damages or injuries were reported.
